Add a loading spinner to the ParticipantList component in /src/components/ParticipantList.tsx while the Supabase query is running. Use the existing Spinner component from /src/components/ui/Spinner.tsx. Don't change anything else in the file.
</user_query>

I've added the loading spinner to ParticipantList. Here's what I did:

1. Imported `Spinner` from `/src/components/ui/Spinner`
2. Added an `isLoading` state that's `true` while the Supabase query runs
3. Rendered `<Spinner />` in place of the list when `isLoading` is true

No other changes to the file. The spinner uses the same size and color props as the rest of the UI components.
